title.zh-TW: 每月首階消費最高 3% 回饋（VIP 4%）
title.en: Up to 3% cash back on the first monthly band (4% for VIP)

text.zh-TW: Core 首 $2,000、Luxe 首 $10,000、Pinnacle 首 $50,000 為 3%；VIP 首 $50,000 為 4%。超過首階降為 1%，再降為 0.5%；以 ETHFI 發放，鎖定 7 天。
text.en: 3% on the first $2,000 (Core), $10,000 (Luxe) or $50,000 (Pinnacle); 4% on the first $50,000 for VIP. Above that 1%, then 0.5%; paid in ETHFI with a 7-day lock.

title.zh-TW: Core 為預設方案，含 1 張免費虛擬卡
title.en: Core is the default tier, with 1 free virtual card

text.zh-TW: 實體卡費用與其他方案的免費卡片數，官方兩頁說明不一致，請以 App 為準。
text.en: The physical card fee and the free card counts of other tiers differ between two official help pages; the app prevails.

title.zh-TW: 指定訂閱分類最高 30% 回饋（Luxe 起）
title.en: Up to 30% back on a subscription category (Luxe and above)

text.zh-TW: Luxe 10%、Pinnacle 20%、VIP 30%，每月上限 10、20、30 美元。分類是指定的訂閱品牌，經 App Store 計費或綁在其他產品的訂閱不計；每 30 天可換一次分類。
text.en: Luxe 10%, Pinnacle 20%, VIP 30%, capped at $10, $20, $30 a month. Named subscription brands only; app-store billing excluded; change category every 30 days.

title.zh-TW: ATM 每月免手續費提領

text.zh-TW: Core、Luxe 每月 10 次；Pinnacle、VIP 不限次數。提領本身不計回饋。
text.en: 10 per month for Core and Luxe; unlimited for Pinnacle and VIP. Withdrawals earn no cash back.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（邀請碼 32c0a418 已在連結中，邀請頁也會顯示）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (the code 32c0a418 is already in the link and shown on the invite page).

steps.zh-TW: 依畫面完成註冊與身分驗證（KYC）；官方推薦條款要求雙方年滿 18 歲，並住在卡片與計畫有提供的地區。
steps.en: Register and complete identity verification (KYC); the referral terms require both parties to be 18 or older and to live where the card and program are offered.

steps.zh-TW: 申請並啟用 Cash Card。依條款，連結須在建立後 90 天內使用，並在卡片啟用後 30 天內完成符合資格的消費，推薦才可能被計入；官方說明中心另寫需累積 $100 美元的符合資格消費。
steps.en: Apply for and activate the Cash Card. Per the terms, use the link within 90 days and spend within 30 days of activation (help center: $100 eligible).

intro.zh-TW: ether.fi Cash 提供的加密貨幣信用卡：非託管帳戶，每月首階消費最高 3% 回饋（VIP 4%），回饋以 ETHFI 發放並鎖定 7 天。
intro.en: A crypto credit card from ether.fi Cash: non-custodial account, up to 3% cash back on the first monthly band (4% for VIP), paid in ETHFI, locked 7 days.

description.zh-TW:
ether.fi Cash Card 是 ether.fi Cash 提供的加密貨幣信用卡（Visa Signature），可用非託管帳戶中的加密資產消費。邀請頁註明：此卡與 ether.fi 協議沒有隸屬關係，由發卡機構依另訂條款發行。

方案與回饋（取自 ether.fi 說明中心，頁面多半沒有標示更新日期，實際以 App 內顯示為準）：

- **Core**：預設方案；每月首 $2,000 消費 3% 回饋；ATM 每月 10 次免手續費。
- **Luxe**：以 5,000 點（每月需 5,000 點維持）、Liquid 15,000 美元、質押 30,000 顆 ETHFI 或年費 199 美元／年解鎖；每月首 $10,000 消費 3%；指定訂閱 10% 回饋（每月上限 10 美元）；ATM 每月 10 次免手續費。
- **Pinnacle**：25,000 點、Liquid 100,000 美元、質押 150,000 顆 ETHFI 或年費 999 美元／年解鎖；每月首 $50,000 消費 3%；指定訂閱 20%（上限 20 美元）；ATM 不限次數。
- **VIP**：Liquid 500,000 美元或質押 500,000 顆 ETHFI；每月首 $50,000 消費 4%；指定訂閱 30%（上限 30 美元）；ATM 不限次數。

超過首階的消費，回饋降為 1%，再降為 0.5%。回饋以 ETHFI 發放並鎖定 7 天；提款機提領、轉帳、換匯、賭博等不計回饋。
description.en:
The ether.fi Cash Card is a crypto credit card (Visa Signature) from ether.fi Cash that lets you spend crypto held in a non-custodial account. The invite page states that the card is not affiliated with the ether.fi protocol and is issued by an issuer under separate terms.

Tiers and rewards (from the ether.fi help center, most pages show no update date; what the app shows prevails):

- **Core**: the default tier; 3% cash back on the first $2,000 per month; 10 free ATM withdrawals per month.
- **Luxe**: unlocked with 5,000 points (5,000 per month to keep it), $15,000 in Liquid, 30,000 staked ETHFI or $199 a year; 3% on the first $10,000 per month; 10% on a chosen subscription category (up to $10 per month); 10 free ATM withdrawals per month.
- **Pinnacle**: 25,000 points, $100,000 in Liquid, 150,000 staked ETHFI or $999 a year; 3% on the first $50,000 per month; 20% on a subscription category (up to $20 per month); unlimited free ATM withdrawals.
- **VIP**: $500,000 in Liquid or 500,000 staked ETHFI; 4% on the first $50,000 per month; 30% on a subscription category (up to $30 per month); unlimited free ATM withdrawals.

Spending above the first band earns 1%, then 0.5%. Cash back is paid in ETHFI with a 7-day lock; ATM withdrawals, transfers, currency exchange and gambling earn none.

notes.zh-TW: 資料取自 ether.fi 官方頁面與說明中心（2026-10-25 讀取；多頁沒有標示更新日期，彼此也有不一致，例如免費虛擬卡與實體卡的數量與費用），以 App 內顯示為準。邀請頁註明此卡與 ether.fi 協議沒有隸屬關係，由發卡機構依另訂條款發行。官方的推薦機制自 2026-05-01 起改為聯盟計畫，邀請人的獎勵取決於聯盟等級，被邀請人的專屬獎勵官方沒有寫。聯盟條款禁止自我推薦、誤導性行銷，以及未經授權把推薦連結放在付費廣告。官方沒有公布支援地區清單，台灣是否可申請本站沒有驗證，也沒有測試邀請碼是否被接受。加密資產與 DeFi 產品風險高，可能損失本金，費用請自行確認，並遵守所在地法規。 etherfi.gitbook.io 是 ether.fi 放在 GitBook 的文件站（共用服務，只列這個完整主機），聯盟條款在那裡。
notes.en: Data comes from ether.fi's official pages and help center (read on 2026-10-25; many pages show no update date and they disagree in places, for example the number and fees of free virtual and physical cards); the app prevails. The invite page states that the card is not affiliated with the ether.fi protocol and is issued by an issuer under separate terms. Since 2026-05-01 the official referral scheme is the Affiliate Program: the referrer's reward depends on the affiliate tier, and no reward specific to the invited person is stated. The affiliate terms prohibit self-referrals, deceptive marketing and unauthorized placement of referral links in paid advertising. ether.fi publishes no list of supported regions, so whether it can be applied for in Taiwan was not verified, and acceptance of the code was not tested. Crypto assets and DeFi products carry a high level of risk and you may lose your principal; check fees yourself and follow local laws. etherfi.gitbook.io is ether.fi's documentation site on GitBook (a shared service, so only this full host is listed); the affiliate terms are there.

q.zh-TW: 透過推薦連結註冊 ether.fi Cash Card 有什麼好處？
q.en: What do I get by signing up for the ether.fi Cash Card through the referral link?

a.zh-TW: 可享有 ether.fi 官方提供的卡片回饋，具體額度以官方當期方案與 App 內顯示為準，例如 Core 方案每月首 $2,000 消費 3%，以 ETHFI 發放並鎖定 7 天。不過官方邀請頁只寫「最高 3% 回饋，加上其他獎勵」，說明中心與推薦條款也沒有列出被邀請人的專屬獎勵，所以本站不另列邀請獎勵；3% 是卡片本身的回饋，不是邀請獎勵。邀請碼是 32c0a418。
a.en: You get the card rewards ether.fi offers; the exact amounts follow the official current plan and what the app shows, for example 3% on the first $2,000 per month on Core, paid in ETHFI with a 7-day lock. The official invite page, however, only says "up to 3% cash back plus more rewards", and neither the help center nor the referral terms list a reward specific to the invited person, so none is listed here; the 3% is the card's own cash back, not an invite reward. The code is 32c0a418.

a.zh-TW: 以 ETHFI 發放：消費入帳後先換算並鎖定 7 天，之後到 Cashback 頁領取。ETHFI 價格會波動，退款或撤銷會扣回對應回饋。
a.en: It is paid in ETHFI: once a purchase clears it is converted and locked for 7 days, then you claim it on the Cashback page. The ETHFI price can move, and refunds or reversals take the matching cash back back.

q.zh-TW: ether.fi Cash Card 在台灣哪些商家能刷？
q.en: Which Taiwan merchants accept the ether.fi Cash Card?

a.zh-TW: 官方沒有公布台灣商家清單。第三方的社群實測整理（penchan.co，作者標示資料截至 2026 年 9 月）指出：能否刷過取決於支付通路（LINE Pay、Apple Pay、Google Pay、線上輸入卡號）與店家的收單系統，同一家店在不同通路結果可能相反；LINE Pay 是主要的基準通路，但部分便利商店曾回報「不支援的發卡銀行」；全聯、綠界、Netflix、Steam 等被列為多通路失敗的商家；電信費直接扣繳有被封卡的風險，建議先小額試刷。這是他人的實測回報，本站沒有自行驗證，結果會隨發卡與收單政策變動。
a.en: ether.fi publishes no list of Taiwan merchants. A third-party community test roundup (penchan.co; the author says the data runs to September 2026) reports that success depends on the payment channel (LINE Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, typing the card number online) and on the merchant's acquirer, so the same shop can give opposite results on different channels; LINE Pay is the main baseline channel, but some convenience stores reported "unsupported issuing bank"; PX Mart, ECPay, Netflix and Steam are listed as failing on several channels; paying telecom bills directly risks a card block, so test with a small amount first. These are other people's test reports that this site has not verified, and results change with issuer and acquirer policies.
